patterns.source: skill/anti_patterns.md, A9 'Paper-by-paper literature' (general craft knowledge; not extracted from a specific bad exemplar, since no external corpus is available under the no-web constraint, AR-003)
patterns.rhetorical_purpose: A writer under time pressure lists what each prior benchmark does, one after another, instead of organizing by the dimension that explains the Gap.
move_sequence: no synthesis sentence connecting them to a single missing capability
patterns.reader_question_answered: none: this is the failure mode to avoid, watched for while drafting the new paper's Background/Related-Work section
patterns.transition_behavior: Consecutive sentences share no logical connective beyond addition ('Also,' 'Additionally').
patterns.signature: 3+ consecutive 'X did A. Y did B. Z did C.' sentences with no dimension-level synthesis
patterns.reader_effect: No gap emerges; the reader cannot tell which missing capability motivates the new suite.
patterns.repair_principle: Organize by dimension (problem framing, memory footprint, power measurement) as in corpus/literature_map.json, and close with one synthesis sentence naming what none of the three provides.

patterns.source: skill/anti_patterns.md, A6 'Result dumping' (general craft knowledge; watched for while drafting the Results section, which otherwise risks listing Table 1's four accuracy numbers and Table 2's five hardware platforms with no interpretation between them)
patterns.rhetorical_purpose: A writer transcribes every number from Tables 1-2 and Section 6.2 in sequence, trusting the numbers to speak for themselves.
move_sequence: move on with no comparison, no reference point, no claim tag
patterns.reader_question_answered: none: this is the failure mode to avoid
patterns.result_interpretation_pattern: Absent: numbers given with no 'how large,' 'is it robust,' or 'what does it mean' step.
patterns.signature: 3+ consecutive numeric sentences with no interpretive clause
patterns.reader_effect: The reader cannot tell which numbers matter or what they establish (fails Q7/Q8 of the reconstruction test).
patterns.repair_principle: Apply the Result Interpretation Chain per benchmark result and per submission-round finding; put the full per-benchmark numbers in the Markdown comparison table and keep the prose for the one or two numbers that answer the research question.
